chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 192: Keke Defies Reincarnation & Dragon's Last Stand
chapter_meta_description: Keke is cast into reincarnation by a treacherous blow. The Little Defiant Dragon fights to the death, then Keke returns from the void, tearing open the gates of hell.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 192: Stubborn Pride, Return!
og_description: A devastating betrayal sends Keke into the cycle of rebirth, but the little beast defies fate itself to return and seek vengeance.
twitter_description: The Golden Lion King's treachery backfires as Keke shatters the reincarnation gate and the Little Defiant Dragon makes a suicidal stand.
